verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a full self-hosted stack (develop.sentry.dev/self-hosted) and some long-term users report rock-solid production experience, but the founder himself concedes self-hosting is 'awful today' and community reports describe runaway container/memory growth and a near-production-outage from database issues — concrete contradictions to the 'documented, production-ready' claim. missing for 10: a documented upgrade-path guide, official production reference architecture, and resolution of the resource-growth/database complaints.
